Ruling: representation; the project asks f1116sb.prior_year only when line 6 (an excess generated) is above zero and takes prior_none otherwise; the reply reads the input with the same line 6 test inside its condition. Same refusal where both evaluate; differences are project-unknown (64 completed, 67 incomplete, 79 refused: returns off the Form 1116 path whose line 6 is not figured) and 2 candidate-refuses on already refused returns. i1116sb p. 2 and D1 (no carryback; a 2024 year with room refuses).

Source: i1116sb, line 2 adjustments (refused, Schedule B line 2).
